title: Template Library — Phase 1
topic: Example scenes for the three documentary templates
script:
Among the rulers later hidden in the cache was Ramesses the Second, who reigned for sixty-six years.

Their original burial places had been threatened by thieves. Gold vanished, coffins were damaged, and royal mummies were disturbed.

Priests of Amun repaired damaged burials and carefully rewrapped royal bodies in fresh linen.
